scope: OfflineRenderer.swift preparation, resampling, timing, accumulation, export finalization
C target integration and linked exact coefficient behavior
result: No actionable core correctness defect found in the inspected bounded contracts; 16 synthetic integration tests pass.
static_review: Project schema rejects duplicate track/clip IDs, nonfinite/out-of-range controls and invalid clip times before saving or preparing.

Media resolution rejects traversal, absolute paths, malformed separators, a redirected Media directory, external symlink targets and nonregular files. Tests exercise ordinary import, file escape, directory redirect, load rejection and source removal.
Preparation determines audible clips by solo and mute, preserves timeline endpoints independently of audibility, applies explicit application pan/gain policy and bounds decoded/prepared frame counts.
Clips select source intervals and independently rounded timeline position/length. Linear resampling is an application choice, not recovered Cubase processing.

Offline summing uses stable track/clip order, permits unclipped float peaks above one, and export writes chunks to a temporary file before move/replace. Tests inspect replacement, chunk boundary and source preservation.
Playback reuses prepared buffers, but native audio engine timing/device output remains an untested runtime surface.
dsp_scope: Four channels only, explicit normalized direction, nonbypass, zero silence flags, positive bounded frames, disjoint buffers, nearest rounding, signed zero or conservative normal magnitude domain; kernel policy rejections are not claimed target behavior.
important_bit_check: binary64 inverse gain is 0x3fe6a09e667f3bcc, one ULP below sqrt(0.5); linked test checks exact bits and distinguishes textbook substitution.
uncovered: Full floating-point domain and any Cubase runtime equivalence
